info.name: Narmi Public account balances express-checkout API

items.docs: Creates a Stripe SetupIntent for collecting payment method details via Express Checkout Element (Apple Pay, Google Pay) without immediate charge. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Retrieves card brand and last4 digits from a Stripe payment method for display purposes.
